```{r function_all_ar_res}

all_ar_res <- function(dat)
{
  outc_sourc_metr_liste <- dat %>%
    filter(risk_type == "absolute_risk") %>%
    select(outcome, source, metric, bhd) %>%
    unique()
  
  print("hier wird diese Outcome-Liste berücksichtigt:")
  print(outc_sourc_metr_liste)
  outcome_ar <- NULL
  
  # Basic for loop iteration
  for (i in 1:nrow(outc_sourc_metr_liste)) {
    zeile <- outc_sourc_metr_liste[i, ]
    print("Nun Kombi:")
    print(zeile)
    osm <- dat %>%
      filter(outcome == zeile$outcome,
             source == zeile$source,
             metric == zeile$metric)
    outcome_ar <-
      calc_macro_ar_impact(osm) %>%
      rbind(outcome_ar)# Assuming this function returns a data frame
  }
  return(outcome_ar)
}

all_rr_res <- function(dat)
{
  outc_sourc_metr_liste <- dat %>%
    filter(risk_type == "relative_risk") %>%
    filter(!is.na(bhd)) %>% #bhd is needed in calc_macro_rr_impact; better error handling would be nice: throw warning, return line with NA in certain datafield and continue
    select(outcome, source, metric, bhd) %>%
    unique()
  
  print("hier wird diese Outcome-Liste berücksichtigt:")
  print(outc_sourc_metr_liste)
  outcome_rr <- NULL
  
  # Basic for loop iteration
  for (i in 1:nrow(outc_sourc_metr_liste)) {
    zeile <- outc_sourc_metr_liste[i, ]
    print("Nun Kombi:")
    print(zeile)
    osm <- dat %>%
      filter(outcome == zeile$outcome,
             source == zeile$source,
             metric == zeile$metric)
    outcome_rr <-
      calc_macro_rr_impact(osm) %>%
      rbind(outcome_rr)# Assuming this function returns a data frame
  }
  return(outcome_rr)
}
```
